title: Staging Activation Recovery trusted-ingress provisioning and durable replay convergence

phases.objective: Provision the missing Staging Activation Recovery Worker signing authority, bind its exact deployed public trust into the local Staging origin, provide durable single-filesystem replay claims for local Windows/Docker, and make One-Click recover the trusted-ingress gap even when ordinary Gateway health is already green, without using Local Connector authority or synthesizing certification readiness.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Docker Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The governed exact-main Worker deployment owns an independent Ed25519 Recovery ingress private key, publishes only the matching public origin-trust artifact after exact-SHA Worker readback, One-Click hydrates only non-secret exact trust into ignored local Staging configuration, the origin atomically consumes Recovery JTIs from persistent app storage, and /admin/recovery/staging/* can reach the bounded Recovery surface without connector.mad4b.com or Production authority. Certification may still report blocked until genuine signed readiness evidence exists.
steps: Bind smart convergence to an exact current origin/main commit and a passed Staging schema/governance preflight.
Build the Staging Activation Worker with an independent Ed25519 Recovery ingress signing keypair separate from the policy-attestation key.

Place the ingress private JWK and key ID only in the ephemeral Wrangler secrets file; emit a public-only origin-trust artifact with exact source SHA, Worker source-set digest, policy hash, issuer, audience and key ID.
Deploy through the existing governed Staging Worker workflow and publish the origin-trust artifact only after public exact-SHA health readback succeeds.
Download that exact workflow-run artifact locally and hydrate only the public trust fields into ignored .env.staging.
Decode the single-line escaped public PEM at the origin trust boundary and verify issuer, audience, host, exact deployment SHA, request bindings and key ID.
Use the deployment-owned absolute /app/data/recovery-ingress path for atomic single-filesystem replay claims only in local Windows/Docker Staging when no higher authority injected a replay store.
Run the Staging One-Click core once more after convergence so the app restarts with the exact trusted-ingress configuration.
assertions: connector.mad4b.com is not a route, fallback, authority source or provisioning dependency for Staging Activation Recovery.
The Worker Recovery private key never appears in origin-trust.json, .env.staging, workflow summaries or repository evidence.
The public origin-trust artifact is uploaded only after successful Worker deployment and exact-SHA public health readback.
Local Recovery replay claims use the canonical durable replay-store contract and atomic exclusive filesystem claims; missing or invalid replay authority still fails closed.
Green /health alone does not suppress Recovery trust convergence; gateway_recovery_trusted_ingress is a typed recoverable Staging-only reason.

No Production deployment, Production mutation, Cloudflare DNS mutation, Hostinger mutation, database mutation, migration apply, ruleset mutation or synthetic live certification is authorized by this feature.

phases.objective: Production Recovery activation, Production trusted-ingress provisioning and Production provider/database mutation remain outside this feature.
blockers: Production requires its separate governed release, trust provisioning, certification and authorization lifecycle.
This feature grants no Production database, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare DNS, deployment or Recovery execution authority.
